data.title: 菲奥娜 · 雨夜公用电话亭暗号接头
data.description: 【菲奥娜 · 雨夜公用电话亭暗号接头】冷雨绵绵的柏林特深夜街头，深蓝双排扣大衣下包裹着挺拔冷艳的身姿。菲奥娜一手收拢黑伞靠在玻璃门侧，一手握住泛着微温的黑色听筒。电话亭顶灯昏黄的暖光穿透雨水滑落的玻璃壁，描摹出她冷若冰霜的侧颜与被右侧长刘海遮住半边的脸。在毫无波澜的语调下，西国代号「夜帷」的密文准确无误地传出。

data.promptProse: Fiona stands inside a rain-streaked Berlint phone booth, holding a black receiver and keeping her folded umbrella beside the glass door. Her dark-blue double-breasted coat covers a purple turtleneck and leather trousers in the cowboy view. Long bangs conceal the right side of her composed face. The booth's yellow lamp lights her glove and profile through wet glass, while cold street reflections mark the lower panels.
